meta.as_of_display: Tourist presence: Airbnb snapshot 16 Jun 2026 | Landmarks: pageviews to 31 May 2026 | Events: Paris export 05 Oct 2026 (2025-10 to 2026-09)
meta.low_signal_rule: All three raw signals are 0, or nbhd_total < 8 (Market Watch minimum for reliable neighborhood ranking).
meta.robust_gap_rule: Cell is robust_gap when it appears in the top-30 gap list for at least 6 of 10 buzz-weight variants (7 component combos + three 2:1:1 weightings).
meta.gap_ranking_rule: Gap shortlist and gap map ranking exclude low-signal cells and cells with venue_count < 15 (thin supply).
meta.saturation_source: market_cell_stats.own_count (cuisine_group ALL, active venues in cell hex)
meta.buzz_index_formula: Mean of enabled normalized components (default: all three, equal weight).
meta.normalization_rule: raw=0 → normalized 0; raw>0 → percentile among positive cells, scaled 1–100, tie-averaged ranks
meta.bivariate_threshold: 50th percentile of buzz index and saturation among non-low-signal cells
meta.seasonality_formula: sum(top 3 monthly buzz values) / sum(12 months); 0.25 = flat, 1.0 = concentrated
meta.buzz_ui_default_note: Buzz map UI defaults to tourist presence + landmark attention; events off (patchy cell coverage). robust_gap precompute still evaluates all component-weight variants.
meta.opportunity_osm_digital_note: Explore Opportunity uses a separate OSM tag-share digital proxy; this buzz index uses tourist, landmark, and event proxies only.
